description:
JMP offers a 30-day free trial for anyone, anywhere. Go to https://www.jmp.com/scishow  to see the benefits of visual statistics for yourself. 

For decades, the Giant Impact Hypothesis has been the leading theory for the Moon's formation. But there's a lot of weird Moon things it still can't explain. A recent theory involving /three/ impacts might shed new light on our peculiar and precious Moon.

Hosted by: Savannah Gear (they/them)
